title: "SENSOR NOT FOUND"
body:
Did anyone ever received this message?
I changed my sensor today, and also replaced miao miao. I did everything same as always, but today it gave me this error(the sensor is working fine on the libre monitor) and i don't know why. Can anyone help me? Thanks

comments.body:
Make sure miaomiao is very tight to sensor.
Try also resetting the miaomiao.

Yeah, it was the first thing i did...reset and i make sure that it is well placed( i also have a holder band to make sure that the sensor and the miaomiao don't fall).
The only 2 situations that xdrip registed something was when i putt pressure on miaomiao and the sensor, but for the next minutes stoped again :(
It looks like a problem of the sensor in combination with Miaomiao and not related to xDrip.

Yeah, i'm starting to think so... Well, i will wait for the Next sensor use.
Thank you for the help
